body_lead: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and Finance Minister Ajit Pawar on Monday tabled a Rs 7.20 lakh crore annual state budget for 2025-26 with Rs 45,892 crore revenue deficit and Rs 1,36,234 crore fiscal deficit. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis lauded the state budget and said apart from Uttar Pradesh with 22 crore population, Maharashtra with 12 crore population is the only state that has proposed a Rs 7.20 lakh crore budget, indicating the mammoth scale of the exercise.
